metadata.question: Did the Alisal Fire cover less than 10,000 acres from October 11, 2021 to October 13, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about the Alisal Fire coverage from October 11-13, 2021. This is a specific fire event that occurred in California. To answer this, I need to: 1. Identify the fire location and get burned area data 2. Calculate the total burned area in acres 3. Compare with 10,000 acres Best approach: - Use the MODIS Burned Area product (MCD64A1) which provides monthly burned area data - Filter for October 2021 and the Alisal Fire region - Calculate total burned area and convert to acres - Compare with 10,000 acres threshold The Alisal Fire was in Santa Barbara County, California. I'll define a region around that area. Data strategy: - Collection: MCD64A1 (MODIS Burned Area Monthly) - Date: October 2021 (covers the period) - Location: Bounding box around Santa Barbara County - Processing: Sum burned area pixels and convert to acres I need to handle: - Checking if collection has data - Counting valid pixels - Converting from square meters to acres (1 acre = 4046.86 square meters) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Alisal Fire was in Santa Barbara County, California var fireRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-120.5, 34.3, -119.8, 34.8]); var startDate = '2021-10-01'; var endDate = '2021-10-31'; // Using full month since MCD64A1 is monthly // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Burned Area Monthly product var burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(fireRegion); var collectionSize = burnedArea.size().getInfo(); print('October 2021 Burned Area Images: ' + collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { print('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Get burned area for October 2021 var octoberBurned = burnedArea.first().select('BurnDate'); // Create mask for burned pixels (values 1-366 indicate burn day of year) var burnedMask = octoberBurned.gt(0).and(octoberBurned.lte(366)); var burnedAreaImage = burnedMask.selfMask(); // 4. Calculate burned area statistics var pixelArea = burnedAreaImage.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); // Area in square meters var totalArea = pixelArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: fireRegion, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); var pixelCount = burnedAreaImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: fireRegion, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate'); var areaSqM = totalArea.getInfo(); var count = pixelCount.getInfo(); print('Burned pixels: ' + count); if (count === 0 || areaSqM === null) { print('No burned area detected in region.'); print('C2'); return; } // Convert from square meters to acres var areaAcres = areaSqM / 4046.86; print('Burned area: ' + areaAcres.toFixed(2) + ' acres'); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (areaAcres === null || areaAcres < 0 || areaAcres > 1000000) { print('C3'); } else if (areaAcres < 10000) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
